nodes.description: Public transfer entry point that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the _from argument.
Internal whitelist gate: short-circuits to true for owner, UNI pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise enforces condition().
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum and calls ensure(); arithmetic is unchecked.
Public payable approve writing the caller's allowance mapping.
Internal view sale-condition checker reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-gated function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address and bytes payload.
Privileged mint function that overwrites balanceOf for an arbitrary address and whitelists it via canSale.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum sale limits.
Owner-only batch distribution looping over _tos; total and balance updates use unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
Internal pure helper computing a Uniswap-style pair address via keccak256.
Constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and initial balances/allowance.
Private SafeERC20 helper performing a low-level call on an arbitrary token address.
Private address holding privileged control of the token.
Public mapping of account balances, directly mutated by transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spend allowances mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Private whitelist mapping that bypasses the sale condition check.
Private per-address counter of sales used by condition() and incremented in transferFrom.
Private maximum number of sales per address, set in init().
Private minimum transfer value enforced by condition().
Private maximum transfer value enforced by condition().
Whitelisted trade address that bypasses the ensure() check when used as _from.
Public total token supply set in the constructor.
Constant public decimals value (18) used in mint and init scaling.
Caller-controlled origin of every external call; used as _from, for allowance gating and for owner checks.
Arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address, executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked multiplication `_value * _tos.length` and unchecked balance subtraction in batchSend.
Unchecked `allowance[...] -= _value`, `balanceOf[_from] -= _value` and `balanceOf[_to] += _value` updates.
Unchecked scaling `addedValue * (10**uint256(decimals))` used to overwrite balances.
Low-level `address(token).call(data)` to an arbitrary token address before state is finalized, a reentrancy vector.
Recipient parameter _to of transfer().
Source parameter _from of transferFrom(), compared to msg.sender.
Recipient parameter _to of transferFrom().
Amount parameter _value of transferFrom(), used in unchecked balance arithmetic.
Amount parameter _value of condition(), bounded by _minSale and _maxSale.
Target address parameter a of delegate(), the delegatecall destination.
Calldata bytes parameter b of delegate(), attacker-controlled payload.
Array of recipient addresses _tos in batchSend().
Per-recipient amount _value in batchSend(), multiplied by array length.
Spender address whose balance is overwritten in _mints().
Mint amount addedValue in _mints(), scaled by decimals.
New trade address addr assigned to tradeAddress.
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend().
Local variable _UNI holding the computed pair address inside ensure().

edges.reason: transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
msg.sender is supplied as the _from argument of the internal transferFrom call.
msg.sender is compared against _from to gate the allowance decrement, allowing spending when caller equals _from.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
delegate() executes arbitrary delegatecall code from an attacker-controlled address in this contract's storage context.
_mints() is gated by msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
init() requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner.
Deployer address msg.sender becomes the privileged owner in the constructor.
transferFrom() calls ensure() as a require gate before mutating balances.
ensure() falls through to require(condition(...)) when the whitelist shortcut does not apply.
ensure() computes the UNI pair address via pairFor().
ensure() reads the owner state variable in its whitelist comparison.
ensure() reads tradeAddress as a whitelist bypass condition.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to bypass the sale condition check.
ensure() stores the computed pair address into the local _UNI variable.
condition() reads _saleNum to decide whether per-address sale limits apply.
condition() reads _minSale to bound the transfer value.
condition() reads _maxSale to bound the transfer value.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] and compares it to _saleNum.
The _value parameter flows into condition() where it is compared against _minSale and _maxSale without validated bounds.
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf for both _from and _to.
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() increments the _onSaleNum counter for the source address.
transferFrom() performs unchecked subtraction and addition on allowance and balances.
The _from parameter controls whose allowance and balance are modified.
The _to parameter is the destination of the balance credit.
The _value parameter drives unchecked balance arithmetic in transferFrom().
The _to parameter is forwarded as the recipient of transfer().
_mints() reads owner to validate the caller.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the scaled mint amount.
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting the address.
_mints() computes addedValue * (10**decimals) without overflow protection.
The spender parameter selects which balance is overwritten by _mints().
The addedValue parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals without SafeMath.
init() writes the computed _minSale limit.
init() writes the computed _maxSale limit.
init() writes the _saleNum per-address sale cap.
batchSend() deducts from and credits balanceOf entries for each recipient.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length and subtracts it without overflow checks.
The local total variable is the unchecked product of _value and array length.
The _tos array supplies iteration targets and drives the multiplier for total.
The _value parameter is multiplied by array length and added to each recipient balance.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
The addr parameter becomes the new tradeAddress.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
The constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument.
The constructor credits the full supply to the deployer balance.
The constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
The target address a is the destination of the delegatecall in delegate().
The bytes payload b is executed as code by the delegatecall.
callOptionalReturn() performs a low-level external call on an arbitrary token before verification completes.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter only exists to feed transfer()'s single forwarding call.
The _from parameter is only consumed inside transferFrom() for allowance and balance mutation.
The _to parameter is only used as the balance credit target of transferFrom().
The _value parameter drives the unchecked arithmetic performed by transferFrom().
The _value parameter is only consumed by the min/max sale comparisons inside condition().
The address parameter a is exclusively the target of the delegatecall in delegate().
The bytes parameter b is the payload executed by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
The _tos array is only iterated inside batchSend() to credit balances.
The _value parameter is only used in batchSend()'s unchecked total and balance math.
The spender parameter selects the balance overwritten by _mints().
The addedValue parameter is the operand of the unchecked scaling arithmetic in _mints().
The addr parameter is only assigned into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
The total local variable is a temporary within batchSend() that feeds its balance subtraction.
The _UNI local variable is a temporary whitelist comparison value used only inside ensure().
